# dsh-model-icons

Vendor marks in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI model picker — the same marks the
provider's own dashbo
ard draws next to each model, in the same way it draws them.
| Surface | What appears |

| Composer model menu | one 16 px monochrome mark before every model row |
| Composer model button |

the selected model's mark before its name (14 px) |
| `/model` command popup | the same mark on eve

ry row |
| A skin that redraws the picker (`dsh-claude-style`) | the same mark, and the skin's own l
ockup is hidden in that row so two never meet |

The marks are painted with a CSS mask filled by `currentColor`, which is how the
provider's dashboar

d paints them: one file per vendor serves both palettes and
every row state (hover, selected, disabl
ed) with no colour variants.
## Where the pictures come from

Nothing is embedded in this package. The host half mirrors two public things from
the provider's sit

e into this profile, and the browser half reads them from
loopback:

1. **the model catalog** — the site renders its model table from a JSON island in
its own page (`<sc

ript id="rustvy-catalog">`), so an unauthenticated reader is
handed exactly the data the dashboard s

hows: model id, display name, vendor
and the logo file name that vendor uses. Mirrored to
`<profile>

\.dsh-model-icons\catalog.json`.
2. **the logo files** (`/logos/<name>.svg`) — copied into
`<profile
>\.dsh-model-icons\logos\` on first use.

Both are read on the process's own outbound route (`lib/net.js`): the live global
dispatcher first,

so a proxy installed by `dsh-proxy-gui` — or any other route the
process has — is followed, and a co

nnector built here from `HTTPS_PROXY` /
`ALL_PROXY` / `HTTP_PROXY` second, for the case where no dis

patcher is installed.
`NO_PROXY` is honoured on both. The page itself never leaves the machine: the

browser asks `127.0.0.1` for a mark, which is what makes this work on a machine
whose browser cannot
reach the origin at all.

The catalog refreshes once every 24 hours and on demand; a cold mirror is waited
for up to 6 seconds

, and a stale one refreshes in the background while the rows
keep the marks they have. When the orig

in is unreachable, the cache on disk still
serves everything it holds.
## Matching a row to a mark
Rows are matched by their visible name, in this order:

1. the mirrored catalog's model id (`claude-opus-5-5`, `abyss/glm-5.3`, …);
2. its display name (`OP

lement, so the name is often a prefix rather than the whole string,
and the longest matching id wins

irror has never seen: `claude-*` →
Anthropic, `gpt-*`/`o1…o9` → OpenAI, `glm-*` → Zhipu, `kimi-*`/`k

3` →
Moonshot, `qwen-*` → Alibaba Qwen, `deepseek-*` → DeepSeek, `ahmia-*` → Ahmia,
`mimo-*` → Xiaom
i, `fable-*` → Anthropic, `gemini-*` → Google, `grok-*` → xAI.

A model that matches nothing gets no mark at all — an invented icon would be a
wrong answer rather t

han a missing one. A model that matches but whose logo the
mirror could not fetch gets a monogram ch

ip (the vendor's first letters) instead
of a blank box: a mask whose URL 404s would otherwise paint

s first letters) instead
of a blank box: a mask whose URL 404s would otherwise paint a solid square.

Effort rows, provider headings, the menu's root cells, the search field and
catalog-failure rows are
matched by nothing and stay bare.
## Routes

One prefix registration on the harness's own web server. Plugin routes are not
seen by the host's re

quest fence, so every one of them checks the peer itself:
loopback only, a loopback `Host`, a same-o

rigin `Sec-Fetch-Site` and a matching
`Origin`.
| Route | Method | Answer |
| `/dsh-model-icons/catalog.json` | GET | the mirrored catalog plus the settings the browser half dr

aws with |
| `/dsh-model-icons/logo/<name>.svg` | GET, HEAD | one cached logo, fetched from the orig
in on first ask; `404` when the origin has no such mark, `400` for any name that is not `[A-Za-z0-9.

_-]+.svg` |
| `/dsh-model-icons/state` | GET | mirror status for the settings page: version, model c

ount, cached logos, route, proxy (credentials masked), cache directory, last error |
| `/dsh-model-i

cons/refresh` | POST | re-read the catalog and re-warm every logo it names |
| `/dsh-model-icons/con
fig` | POST | write settings; never touches the network |
## Settings
**Settings → Иконки моделей**
| Switch | Default | Meaning |

| Показывать иконки моделей | on | master switch; off removes every mark |
| Иконка в кнопке выбранн

ой модели | on | also mark the composer's model button, not just the menu rows |
| Прятать логотипы
других скинов | on | hide a skin's own lockup in a row this plugin marked |
The page also shows what the mirror holds and refreshes it on demand.

Stored in `<profile>\.dsh-model-icons\config.json`. Two environment variables
override it, for a dep

loyment that points the mirror elsewhere or wants the
plugin mounted but inert: `DSH_MODEL_ICONS_ORI

GIN` (default `https://rustvy.xyz`)
and `DSH_MODEL_ICONS_DISABLED=1`. The mark size is a config fiel

d (`size`,
10–32 px, default 16).
## No restarts

The host half reloads itself, the same way `dsh-proxy-gui` does: the loader row
names `./lib/live.js

`, which imports the implementation through a cache-busting
`?rev=` query, and a one-second poll of

the `lib` directory disposes the previous
revision and starts the next one once a changed fingerprin

t repeats. The browser
half arrives in an open page through the harness's own live plugin compositio

n;
a page refresh works too.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Copies the package into `<profile>\node_modules\dsh-model-icons` as a real
directory, regenerates `l

ib/live.js` from `lib/index.js` so the two cannot drift,
